value.rationale: Completeness is the natural information-loss invariant of a sampling system, different from frame stability. The result gives the first possible whole-row erasure count causing incompleteness, classifies every minimal four-row geometry, and identifies the full infinite-dimensional defect isometrically (up to normalization) as L2(0,1/2); the complete-but-nonframe boundary is a substantive contrast rather than a numerical curiosity.
